title: NJ Talingting
text:
NJ Talingting
Hello, world! I’m currently working as a Statistics intern at the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) and a maintainer of several spatial R packages published on the Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN).
My years in public office and studies of statistics near the Cebu Port Authority has deeply grounded my work so that they meet the reality of archipelagic life.
Outside work, I’ve founded PinasR, a centralized repository for R packages made by Filipinos. You may find my core spatial tools at CRAN.

title: Open-Source Software
text:
My open-source R packages are meant to dismantle what I call the “Continental Fallacy” in Spatial Data Science - the systemic bias in global software where the sea is treated as an empty void than a medium of connectivity which erases archipelagic life.






ArchipelagoEngine
Constructs a Spatial Weight Matrix (listw) for Spatial Autoregressive (SAR) model in Island Geographies

View on GitHub View on CRAN








roroph
Transforms the Philippine Nautical Highway System into a Network Graph

View on GitHub View on CRAN








palettephines
Makes spatial map intuitive to the locals
